units.source_text: “我照旧每天去上学，但我总觉得老师站在讲台上讲课的声音离自己很远，

en.t: I kept going to school every day as usual, but I always felt that the teacher's voice lecturing from the platform was very far away from me,
and my studies felt the same way.

units.source_text: 看到书上的字，还没渗到心底便烟霞般地消失不见了。

en.t: When I looked at the words on the page, they vanished like mist before they could sink into the bottom of my heart.

units.source_text: 而且，我变得越来越沉默寡言。

en.t: Besides that, I became more and more silent and withdrawn.

units.source_text: 两三个朋友见状，误以为我耽于冥想，还去告诉别的同学。

en.t: Two or three friends saw this, mistook it for absorption in meditation, and even told the other students so.

units.source_text: 我不想作什么解释，反而乐得他们给我戴上这么一副假面具。

en.t: I had no wish to explain anything, and instead was glad that they had put such a mask on me.

units.source_text: 虽说如此，也许是心怀愧疚的关系吧，有时，我也会突然变得活跃异常，把他们吓一大跳。

en.t: Even so, perhaps because I felt guilty, there were times when I would suddenly become unusually lively and startle them badly.

units.source_text: 我寄宿的这户人家很少有人来，亲戚好像也不多。

en.t: The house where I lodged had few visitors, and it did not seem to have many relatives either.

units.source_text: 虽然小姐的同学偶然来玩，也常常是轻声细语地说一会儿话就回去了，声音小得判断不出来了人。

en.t: Although the young lady's school friends would occasionally come to visit, they usually spoke softly for a little while and then went home, so quietly that one could hardly tell anyone had been there.

units.source_text: 她们是怕吵到我，可我竟然没有意识到。

en.t: They were afraid of disturbing me, but I did not realize it at all.

units.source_text: 相比之下，来找我的朋友，虽说不是多么粗鲁的人，却没有一个顾忌过会不会影响房东。

en.t: By contrast, the friends who came to see me, though they were not especially rough people, never once worried about whether they might disturb my hosts.

units.source_text: 如此一来，仿佛我这个房客成了主人，而小姐反倒沦为房客了。

en.t: In this way, it was as if I, the lodger, had become the master of the house, while the young lady had instead been reduced to the position of a boarder.
